Ticket T-0114 (SENSITIVE; Opus security review after): expose the owner-action routes on the watch server. The contract contracts/watch-s4-ops.json defines POST /api/owner/actions/{itemId}/prepare, POST /api/owner/actions/{itemId}/decision and GET /api/owner/audit (request/response schemas, status codes, security: x-watch-token header + tailnet sign-in only; the t query parameter refused). The handlers already exist: tools/board-owner-actions.mjs createOwnerActions({ listItems, appendAudit, readAudit, guard, now, randomId, ownerIdentities, verifyIdentity, confirmTtlMs }) returning { prepare, decide, audit } -> { status, body }; read its header comment: T-0114 must set req.tailnetVerified to true ONLY after Tailscale Serve accepted the request on the loopback watch server (the remote board path in tools/watch-server.mjs around line 354 already checks the tailscale-user-login header equals the configured owner login, no Funnel header, named host); direct local requests and Funnel requests must leave it false. guardBoardAction is in tools/board-action-guard.mjs. Acceptance: 'Owner-action routes require tailnet sign-in and honor the action guard.'
DO: (1) tools/watch-server.mjs: route those three paths (POST for prepare/decision with a JSON body capped at 8 KB; GET for audit) only when an ownerActions option is passed (board mode); build req for the handlers with tokenOk (header token only: the query token never counts for owner routes, and the per-port cookie does NOT count either for POST routes, to keep CSRF impossible; a cookie may count for GET /api/owner/audit), tokenInQuery, local (true for a remote board request carrying local=1), agentSession (the existing agent-session marker check if present; else false), tailnetVerified as above, and the headers; reply with the handler's status and JSON body; refuse anything else with the contract codes; keep /api/health and every existing route unchanged. (2) tools/watch-cli.mjs createBoardApi: build ownerActions with listItems from the board inbox items the owner policy leaves to the owner (tools/board-inbox.mjs), appendAudit/readAudit to an append-only file .swarm/owner/audit.ndjson under the registry/home dir the board already uses (mode 0600; one JSON line per entry), guard = guardBoardAction, ownerIdentities = [the remote config's owner login] (empty when remote is not configured, so every request is refused), verifyIdentity = (req, identity) => req.tailnetVerified === true and identity equals that login; pass it to the server only in remote board mode (local-only boards never expose owner routes). (3) tools/board-owner-actions.mjs (Opus low from review sec3c): sweep expired confirm ids on every prepare and decide, and cap pending confirms at 5 per identity (oldest dropped). Tests in tests/board-owner-routes.test.mjs with a real loopback server: owner routes 404 when not in remote mode; refused without header token, with query token only, with cookie only on POST, with wrong or missing tailscale login, with a Funnel header, with local=1; allowed for the owner with header token through the remote path: prepare then decide approve and deny write audit entries; a refused-kind item (deploy, merge, cap) is refused by the guard; replayed confirm refused; expired confirms swept; pending cap enforced; GET audit returns entries newest first with no token in them. Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs, the tools/swarm folder, package files or .github. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/board-owner-routes.test.mjs tests/board-owner-actions-handlers.test.mjs tests/board-action-guard-unit.test.mjs tests/watch-token-urls.test.mjs tests/watch-server.test.mjs tests/remote.test.mjs tests/board-no-money.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`.
